countingMethod: One entry per capture cell (component slug x tenant palette) with document overflow, content outside either viewport edge, or accidental local clipping at a 360px viewport on the chrome-free capture route /probe/engine-modern. Open overlays are exercised before measurement. Touch targets are measured for every tenant and include semantic/custom controls, using an associated label as the checkbox/radio hit area. Measured by e2e/responsive/responsive.spec.ts against the PRODUCTION build. Decrease-only: new entries fail and can never be added by baseline regeneration.
